summary: Responder chain, key equivalents, menus, gesture recognizers, typed drag and drop, dock badge and an AT-SPI accessibility bridge exist. Scroll wheel, hover and tracking areas, custom cursors, Dock menus and Touch Bar are missing.

features.apple: NSEvent, NSResponder, key events, tracking areas, trackpad touches
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 17 tests. responder chain, key combos and focus loop exist; app input is only Down/Move/Up/Cancel, no wheel, hover, tracking areas or nextKeyView (docs/bifrost-ui.md ~line 870)

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/menu.rs, springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs, springboard/ui/src/cursor_art.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs, springboard/sdk/src/status_item.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_dock.rs
features.note: menu bar, validation, key equivalents, status items and Dock badge (Ctx::set_badge) exist; NSCursor shapes (frameResize, columnResize, rowResize, move, rotate, zoom, disappearingItem, operationNotAllowed) exist as ui::cursor::Kind with layered outline/fill art in springboard/ui/src/cursor_art.rs (partial: not yet wired to the compositor, Midget check pending); no custom Dock tile content or Dock menu found

features.apple: NSGestureRecognizer and subclasses (click, pan, magnification, rotation, press)
features.note: recognizer state machines (tap, pan, long press and similar) exist as pure models; no trackpad magnify or rotate from the compositor to apps
typed drag and drop between apps (docs/bifrost-ui.md section 508); the view kit itself has no drag and drop (line ~873), so views need app glue
AT-SPI2 bridge with label/title/help, caret and selection, announcements; the Node is flat so nesting is reported only by ax_tree()

features.apple: NSPasteboard(name:), .general, .drag, .find, clearContents, writeObjects, pasteboardItems, availableType(from:), canReadItem, changeCount
features.note: named boards (app-local except general), multiple items, UTType-conforming reads; the shell wire is flat so only the first item of the general board reaches the shell; needs a Midget check

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 2 tests (earlier part). Since merged with the Transferable pasteboard (host tests only): an item also holds promised types (setDataProvider), converts to and from the wire item; needs a Midget check

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests (earlier part). Since merged with the Transferable pasteboard (host tests only): one PasteboardItem and NativePasteboard::declare_types replace the separate PromiseBoard; lazy in-process promised data, type owners and file promises; not yet carried over the wire to other apps

gaps: Scroll wheel, hover and tracking-area events for apps
Cursor art wired into the compositor with the pointer outline/fill colour setting
Dock tile custom content and Dock menu
Trackpad magnify and rotate gestures to apps
Drag and drop inside the retained view kit
